EmailTemplate.subject: Take your next steps to enrolling at ASU
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Welcome again to New College of Interdisciplinary Arts and Sciences at Arizona State University!
We’re excited that you chose New College to pursue your graduate studies. Your graduate courses are taught by talented research faculty that are eager to share specialized knowledge in their fields of study and cutting-edge methods of interdisciplinary inquiry for the 21st century.
Don’t forget to take your next steps to enroll so you can begin your journey at ASU. We want to make your transition to graduate school as smooth as possible. Please reach out to us at any time with questions you might have. We look forward to seeing you on campus this fall.
Sincerely,
Jan Lacey Academic Success Coordinator Graduate Student Success ncgradadvising@asu.edu 602-543-6266
